# 04-supply — supply ledger

Scheduled, staffed and productive hours by cohort per day, with agents scheduled and in training. Ledger lifecycle: **append**. Every column cites a definition in `01-definitions/` by slug.

**Provenance (phase 0):** synthetic, generated by `sim/generate.ts` with seed `20260720`; ground truth in `sim/GROUND-TRUTH.md`. Regenerate with `bun run sim/generate.ts`. The generator writes `daily-supply.md` beside the CSV.

## File

| File | Grain | Scope | Rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `daily-supply.csv` | day × cohort | Crestline Services and Larkspur home team, days 1–120 | 240 |

## Column → definition

| Column | Definition (slug) | Name | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date`, `day`, `dow` | — | | Day 1 = 2026-07-20 (Mon) |
| `cohort` | — | | `Crestline Services` (vendor) · `Larkspur home team` (in-house) |
| `headcount` | — | | Contracted heads on the book that day (vendor) or assigned heads (home team). 0 before the home team is engaged |
| `agents_scheduled` | — | Agents scheduled | Heads rostered to a shift that day. Vendor schedules arrive as headcount; hours below are derived at 8 h per shift |
| `agents_in_training` | — | Agents in training | Heads in classroom, nesting or a pulled-in training session that day. On days 57–58 Crestline shows 6 here while `agents_scheduled` is unchanged |
| `scheduled_hours` | `scheduled-hours` | Scheduled hours | `agents_scheduled × 8`, plus classroom hours for a cohort in training |
| `staffed_hours` | `staffed-hours` | Staffed hours | Scheduled minus absence (≈5%) |
| `productive_hours` | `productive-hours` | Productive hours | Staffed minus in-day shrinkage (breaks, coaching, training). Nesting: counted at 25% of staffed |
| `shrinkage_pct` | `shrinkage` | Shrinkage (in-day) | `(1 − productive ÷ staffed) × 100`. Base here is staffed, not scheduled; the definition file's planned/unplanned split is not stored in phase 0 |
| `status` | — | | `readiness`, `phase-1 hypercare`, `phase-2 steady state`, `surge add`, `classroom training`, `nesting`, `live`, `not yet engaged` |

Occupancy is not stored here; compute it as `Σ(handled × aht_agent_sec) ÷ 3600 ÷ productive_hours` from `02-demand/` (definition `occupancy`, agent-work numerator).

## What to expect in the data (no interpretation, just layout)

- Crestline headcount steps 16 → 20 on day 37 and 20 → 28 on day 78. Weekday scheduled ≈ 72% of heads, weekend ≈ 58%.
- The home team has classroom hours (productive 0) on weekdays 36–49, nesting hours 50–70, and live hours from day 71.
- Days 57–58 carry `shrinkage_pct` ≈ 43% for Crestline against ≈ 18% on every other day.
